title: SEC4: DEFAULT_BASE_URL doc does not describe KITH_BASE_URL fallback
description: The DEFAULT_BASE_URL doc comment (crates/kithd/src/lib.rs lines 32-37) accurately names KITHD_BASE_URL but a reader cannot tell from the doc that there is also a deprecated KITH_BASE_URL fallback checked at runtime. The runtime behavior is: (1) try KITHD_BASE_URL, (2) try KITH_BASE_URL with a deprecation eprintln, (3) use DEFAULT_BASE_URL. Only step (1) and (3) are visible in the doc. This is a documentation gap, not a code bug. The make_svc.call(peer_addr) comment in main.rs (line 224) is clear and accurate; no issue there.
